cause_quote: The original toast started `globalThis.setTimeout(() => this.dismiss(), options.durationMs ?? DEFAULT_TOAST_DURATION_MS)` unconditionally, so keyboard focus and pointer hover could not delay dismissal.
user_saw: The archive Undo toast disappeared after six seconds even while the user hovered over it or kept keyboard focus on Undo.
summary: The shared toast now pauses expiry while hovered or focused and resumes the remaining time once both interactions end.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff, which added archive Undo with an unconditional dismissal timer and no hover or focus handlers. The toast file's first-parent history shows that the interaction handlers first appeared in this fix, so the reported failure was present when archive Undo shipped.
